_comment: PDF ingest fix (after change sets 2–5): two-column reading order on the EHP papers, and superscript citation markers dropped on the JCU report. Committed before any fix code entered src/. Every value PROVISIONAL — not ratified.

step0.columns: The EHP papers (Allen 2016, Satish 2012) are set in three columns with ~10 px gutters (x 209–218, 385–394). extractPdf.js buckets x into 4 px slots, so a 10 px gutter reads as 8 px and is rejected by COLUMN_GAP_MIN = 10. On pages with a table (Allen p3), table text crosses the gutters and lifts their coverage above GUTTER_COVERAGE_FRAC.
step0.superscripts: extractPdf.js moves every glyph under 0.85 × the page's modal height to the end of the page as a caption or credit. That includes superscript citation markers (JCU, 67 attached to body text), Pew's superscript footnote markers (7) and the subscript 2 of CO2 (Satish, 141). Fixtures A and C have none attached to body text.
step0.sentenceSplit: splitSentences splits only where whitespace follows . ! ?, so 'jobs.¹ The' would not split once the marker is kept.
step0.markers: Numeric markers are detected only in brackets ([7], [7,12]); FOOTNOTE_ANCHOR expects ASCII digits.

seenBeforeWriting: A scratch prototype of the bucket change alone (2 px buckets, 8 px minimum) gave GROBID-sentence coverage Allen 0.667 and Satish 0.661, from 0.065 and 0.037. That coverage is the development metric; the fixtures, the checks and the GROBID link comparison below were not run on any fix.
plan: Gutters: 2 px buckets, 8 px minimum, plus a second pass that accepts a channel where a large share of the page's rows have text on both sides and nothing across (tables crossing it become full-width rows).

Small glyphs touching body text on the same line stay inline: raised digits as Unicode superscripts, lowered digits as Unicode subscripts, joined without a space; captions and credits still go to the page end.
splitSentences accepts terminal punctuation followed by superscript digits.
Superscript digit runs are resolved as numeric markers against a numbered reference list, and as footnote anchors against a Notes list; with neither, they make no link and do not count as evidence.

grobidSentenceCoverage._basis: Share of GROBID body sentences (≥ 60 normalized characters) whose first 60 characters appear in the app's text. Development metric.

grobidWholeSentenceCoverage._basis: The whole GROBID sentence (callouts included) appears in the app's text. Baseline 0.035, 0.026, 0.872.

appReferences._basis: the reference list is read in column order too; baseline 11, 54, 5 against GROBID's 37, 43, 43

fixture-a-cadre.pdfColumnCheck: splice rate ≤ 0.05 and hyphen tells ≤ 5 (its limits)

fixture-b-pew-report.claims: unchanged (the 7 markers come after full stops; the splitter keeps the boundary)
fixture-b-pew-report.flags: unchanged (no numbered reference list; page-foot notes carry no Notes heading)

predictions.checks: npm run check and npm run build pass; the known-good string unchanged
